Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.action

Datensatzklasse ActionDefinition

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.action.ActionDefinition
Datensatzkomponenten:
type - the handler id, always lower case
argument - the argument to pass the handler, never null but possibly empty
public record ActionDefinition(String type, String argument) extends Record
One configured step of an NPC's reaction to an interaction: a handler id and the argument to pass it.

Actions are stored as a type and a string rather than as executable objects, which is what makes them serialisable, editable from a command, and safe to load from a database without deserialising anything. The handler registered under type() decides what the argument means — message treats it as MiniMessage, command as a command line, and an extension's own handler as whatever it likes.

The configuration form is "type: argument", which parse(String) reads and serialize() writes: 


 actions:
   RIGHT_CLICK:
     - "message: <green>Welcome!"
     - "sound: ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP"
     - "command: spawn"
Seit:
1.0.0

    • parse

      public static ActionDefinition parse(String line)
      Parses the "type: argument" configuration form.

      Only the first colon separates the two, so an argument may contain as many further colons as it likes — which it will, because MiniMessage tags and namespaced keys both use them.

      Parameter:
      line - the line to parse
      Gibt zurück:
      the definition
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if line is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if line has no colon, or the part before it is not a valid type

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Gibt an, ob ein anderes Objekt diesem gleich ("equal to") ist. Die Objekte sind gleich, wenn das andere Objekt der gleichen Klasse angehört und alle Datensatzkomponenten gleich sind. Alle Komponenten in dieser Datensatzklasse werden verglichen mit Objects::equals(Object,Object).
      Angegeben von:
      equals in Klasse Record
      Parameter:
      o - das Objekt, mit dem verglichen wird
      Gibt zurück:
      true, wenn dieses Objekt gleich dem Argument o ist, andernfalls false.
